verdict.rationale: AFK is a SaaS operations platform, so a public API is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only its in-product workspace, where it acts on third-party tools such as Mercury and Gusto via scoped OAuth. Nothing documents a public API that users can call to drive AFK itself, and probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
